mapper.select: SELECT id, part_code, part_kind, name, summary, function_text, position_text, performance_relation, display_order, enabled FROM instrument_part WHERE part_kind = #{partKind} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.part_code, p.part_kind, p.name, p.summary, p.function_text, p.position_text, p.performance_relation, p.display_order, p.enabled FROM instrument_part p INNER JOIN string_profile s ON s.part_id = p.id WHERE s.string_no = #{stringNo} AND p.enabled = TRUE
